overall_goal: Measure and add vanilla extract to the bowl, then mix the ingredients.

goals.description: Prepare the vanilla extract and measuring spoon.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the vanilla extract from the cupboard, opens it, and selects the correct measuring spoon from the drying rack.

goals.description: Measure and add the vanilla extract to the bowl.
goals.rationale: The person pours the vanilla extract into the measuring spoon, empties it into the bowl, and uses a teaspoon to scrape out any remaining extract.

goals.description: Mix the ingredients in the bowl.
goals.rationale: The person uses a fork to stir the ingredients together in the bowl and then sets the bowl back on the counter.
